attributes.name: Jheraal
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d8 to your combat check against a bane. If you would shuffle the bane into the deck it came from, you may put it on top of the deck instead.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 1.
